name: Nguyen Anh
role: The surviving Nguyen lord, who rebuilt his strength in the south while the Tay Son brothers fought each other.
known_facts: Survived the Tay Son destruction of the Nguyen lords in 1777.
Allied with Siam, and saw his hopes broken at Rach Gam in 1785.
Was asked for help by Nguyen Nhac during the siege of Quy Nhon.
Used the brothers' quarrel to retake Gia Dinh in 1788.
Rebuilt his forces in the south for more than a decade.
Reunited Vietnam in 1802 and took the reign title Gia Long.
Kept French officers and engineers in his service.
interpretation: A lean, sun-weathered young man of about twenty-six, long-faced with narrow watchful eyes, high cheekbones and a thin moustache. Black hair tied in a topknot. He wears a dark indigo silk coat with a high collar over a pale shirt, a leather belt with a bronze buckle, cotton trousers, leather sandals, and a long straight sword; a small bronze tiger-shaped tally hangs at his belt.
